- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Yamaha P-125 is a digital piano with 88 fully weighted, Graded Hammer Standard (GHS) keys, built-in sounds, compact design, and price around $500-$600.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Korg B1 is a digital piano with 88 natural weighted, hammer-action keys, built-in sounds, slim design, and price around $300-$400.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested questions to help user decide between Yamaha P-125 and Korg B1: piano authenticity, budget, sound variety, portability, and additional features.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended online resources for keyboard tips: KeyboardMag.com, MusicRadar.com, DigitalPianoReviewsGuide.com.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested YouTube channels for keyboard tips: The Piano Guys, HDpiano, Keyboard Keith, Andertons Music Co., MusicGearReview.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested specific videos to check out for keyboard tips: "How to Choose a Digital Piano" by The Piano Guys, "Top 5 Things to Consider When Buying a Digital Piano" by HDpiano, "Digital Piano vs. Keyboard: What's the Difference?" by Keyboard Keith, "How to Choose the Right Keyboard for You" by Andertons Music Co.
- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for online resources or YouTube channels to help choose the right keyboard for their needs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested that incorporating keyboard playing can improve overall musicianship, cognitive skills, and creative expansion.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested that dividing practice time between guitar and keyboard could slow progress on both instruments.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended starting with a manageable commitment for keyboard practice (15-20 minutes) and focusing on the basics.
